about_the_game:
A cozy blend of idle progression, card collecting, and RPG mechanics. Click, collect, and unlock over 1,000 beautifully illustrated waifu cards, some with stunning holographic effects, while enjoying a chill, ambient experience. Explore the world of Vaifurion — a realm shaped by flame, frost, shadow, and light — where the resurfacing of the mythical Eclipse Crown has set countless heroines on a path toward power, purpose, or ruin.

1,000+ Collectible Cards

Holographic effects, multiple rarities, and full collection tracking.

Idle & Active Gameplay

Click your way to progress, or let the game unfold automatically.

Lootbox System

Open Basic, Mystic, Celestial, and Ethereal lootboxes to uncover cards.

Unlockable Gallery & Videos

100+ Achievements

For both casual collectors and completionists.

Relaxing & Stylish UI

Enjoy smooth animations, ambient effects, and a cozy atmosphere.

100+ Custom Music Tracks

To set a certain mood and tone to the game.

Across its continents, you’ll encounter many distinct races, each with their own culture, powers, and secrets. From the radiant Sunchosen and enigmatic Netherbinders, to the playful Slimekin and fierce Flame Succubi, every card you collect tells a story.

Explore unique regions, from the volcanic Ashen Peaks to the twilight-cloaked Nightspire Hollow, the glowing Emerald Vale, and storm-ravaged Tempest Isles. Each area pulses with elemental energy and mystery — and all are connected by whispers of the Eclipse Crown, a forgotten relic that could reshape the world itself.

❖ Wishlist now and prepare for the ultimate card-collecting adventure! ❖

content_descriptors.notes: Vaifurion contains fantasy artwork of female characters wearing revealing outfits and suggestive poses. There is no nudity or explicit sexual content in the base game. Some characters are designed with mature themes (e.g., succubi race), and visual fanservice is part of the collectible experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD or better)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5 or Ryzen 5+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU for smoother animations
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
